milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce slab T-shaped pathway is at spawn-relative (0-2, -1, 3) extending to (1, -1, 8). Target is the middle of the path at (1, 0, 5). Max distance of 6 blocks requires the player to walk forward from spawn toward the slabs (path starts at z=3, so player must move ~3-5 blocks). Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark oak trapdoor is placed flat (open=true) on the floor at the building entrance at spawn-relative (1, 0, 9). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has walked up to the building entrance rather than just seeing it from afar. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking toward the trapdoor.

Uses inventory_has because mining snow_block with a shovel drops 4 snowballs which appear in the player's inventory. The player has been given an iron_shovel specifically for this purpose. Checking for at least 4 snowballs confirms one snow block was successfully mined. The snowballs are not in the starting inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because orange_stained_glass_pane drops nothing when mined without Silk Touch, so inventory_has cannot be used. Instead we verify block removal: originally 2 panes are placed at spawn-relative (1,1,13) and (1,2,13). If at least one is mined, the count in the generous box drops to at most 1. Box [-2,0,10] to [4,4,16] encompasses the entire back section of the building.
